lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to stand in the gate of the LORD's house and proclaim His message to Judah.
God says if they correct their ways, He will let them live there, and not to trust deceptive words.
God asks if they will steal, murder, and burn incense to Molech, then say in His house, "We are delivered."
God asks if His house has become a den of lions, and says He spoke to them again and again.
God says He will do to the house what He did to Shiloh and cast them out of His presence.
